svg.text: ACTUAL USABLE MAT: 34 COLUMNS × 22 ROWS • ALL BUILDING • OUTDOOR APPROACHES OFF-MAT
36×24 MAT • FINAL SESSION 5 PHYSICAL BUILD • DRAW WALLS; TERRAIN OPTIONAL
1 Draw EVERY black wall and leave door gaps.
2 West and south green strips remain OUTSIDE.
3 Mark D1, D4, D5, D6, D7 locked.
4 Draw DESK, COT, SCREEN and TWO LOOMS.
5 Draw BELL in Room 11 and ROPE near 19.
7 Place the miniatures at the letter markers.
Physical walls and doors are NOT required.
Erase each worker count when released.
B #70 Bugbear • p9 back, top right
W #59 Hobgoblin Warrior • p8 front, bottom left
C #72 Hobgoblin Captain • p9 back, bottom right
J #28 Jaroood proxy • p4 front, bottom right
G #121 Gargoyle • p16 front, top left
M #115 Mimic • p15 front, bottom left
E #151 Earth Elemental • p19 back, bottom left
Keep the monsters concealed until encountered.
BELL: Room 11 • pull cord ends in Room 19.
ROPE outside Room 19: Thieves' Tools DC 13
1 grid square = 5 feet. All 12 rooms remain built.
WEST EXIT D1: left edge x=0, y=3–5.
SOUTH EXIT D2: bottom edge y=22, x=20–22.
ORIGIN = NW corner of building (0,0). Existing room geometry is unchanged; all previous map x coordinates shift −2.
BUILD AND PLAY AT A GLANCE
1. Draw the entire 34×22 building. No on-mat outdoor strip or removed room.
2. D1 (west loading) locked after hours. D4–D7 dormitories locked at night.
3. Suite entry D3 spans x27–30 at y12, three squares wide for the 2×2 elemental.
4. Alarm bell in Room 11; exposed cord outside Room 19: DC 13 tools or cut (AC 12, 5 HP).
5. Workers at night: Rooms 9/10/17/18 have 4 / 4 / 5 / 4. Write the counts on the mat.
Earth Elemental #151: x30–32 / y18–20 (2×2) • Elowen (26,18), no mini needed
Outside arrivals and escaping workers are described off-mat. No movement penalty or teleportation is implied.
1 square = 5 feet. Keep the existing interiors, doors, walls, furnishings, and defenders.
